primary.name: Predeclared acceptance-case pass proportion
primary.numerator: Number of exact JSON-deep-equal outputs on all five predeclared cases for the assigned task
primary.comparator: JSON structural deep equality with numeric equality; object key order ignored; array order significant.
primary.failure: Missing outputs, exceptions, timeout, crash or malformed output count as a failed case. Do not drop failed cases.
primary.aggregation: Report task-level passes/5 and condition-level task averages, with all denominator counts; no pooled causal effect asserted from pilot.

secondary.wall_time_seconds: Measured from ready-to-start until submission, including waiting and retries.
secondary.active_human_seconds: Separately self-recorded active human time; may be imprecise.
secondary.human_corrections: Count participant corrective turns and edits separately.
secondary.unaided_explanation: Blinded rubric of 0,1,2 after AI access ends: 0 cannot explain main flow, 1 partial, 2 correct explanation of flow and an edge case.
secondary.unaided_modification: Binary precommitted post-task modification pass, scored without model assistance.
secondary.resource_cost: Record measured provider usage and price assumptions; unknown is permitted.

handling.missing: Keep failed and incomplete trials in denominator; report attrition.
handling.exploratory: All unlisted analyses explicitly marked exploratory.
handling.negative: Publish null, harmful and contrary observations alongside favorable ones.
handling.external_validity: Tasks and acceptance cases are openly accessible. A future separate holdout and externally calibrated task matching are needed for broad claims.
